questions.q: Where do you assign members to an RLS role after publishing?
options: Hover over the semantic model in the service, open More options, and select Security
Power BI Desktop's Manage Roles dialog
The workspace's general Settings page
It's automatic — every workspace member is assigned to every role
questions.explain: Member assignment is a service-only step, reached by hovering the semantic model to reveal More options, then selecting Security.

questions.q: Why might the Security option not appear for a semantic model at all?
options: The semantic model has no RLS roles defined yet in Power BI Desktop
The workspace has too many members
The semantic model is too large
Security is a Premium-only feature
questions.explain: Security only appears once at least one role has already been defined in Desktop and published — without a defined role, there's nothing to manage membership for.

questions.q: Which group type is explicitly NOT supported for RLS role membership?
options: Microsoft 365 groups
Distribution groups
Mail-enabled groups
Microsoft Entra security groups
questions.explain: Microsoft 365 groups can't be added to any RLS role. Distribution groups, mail-enabled groups, and Microsoft Entra security groups are all supported.

questions.q: What does the number in parentheses next to a role's name (e.g. 'West Sales (3)') represent?
options: The number of members currently assigned to that role
The number of DAX filter expressions applied to the role
The number of tables the role filters
The role's priority ranking among all roles
questions.explain: That count is a quick-glance member tally — it updates whenever a member is added or removed from the role.

questions.q: Who is permitted to see the Security option and assign members to RLS roles?
options: Users with the workspace Contributor role or higher (semantic model ownership or Build permission may also be required)
Only the original creator of the Power BI Desktop file, forever
Every workspace Viewer automatically
Only Microsoft support staff
questions.explain: Contributor role or higher is the baseline requirement to see and use Security — ownership or Build permission on the semantic model can also factor in depending on the scenario.
